shield.name: Orc Shieldbearer
shield.threat: Heavy armor · use piercing or magic

berserker.name: Orc Berserker
berserker.threat: Enrages below half health · slow or burst

wolf.name: Wolf Rider
wolf.threat: Fast elite beast · frost and beast hunters

sapper.name: Goblin Sapper
sapper.threat: Scorches barricades · briefly weakens adjacent towers

warlock.name: Orc Warlock
warlock.threat: Magic ward aura · use physical and piercing

wyvern.name: Wyvern Rider
wyvern.threat: Flying · ignores your maze, follows checkpoints

warlord.name: Ghorun, the Hollow Crown
warlord.threat: Legendary warlord · piercing, holy and a long maze

host_01.name: Orc Skull Scavengers
host_01.threat: Opening patrol · no armor or resistances
host_01.counter: Keep a defender near a checkpoint or crossing, then strengthen your defense each round.
host_01.appearance: Small green orcs in ragged hoods. They carry rusty cleavers and sacks of loot: the first and least equipped ranks of the army.

host_02.name: Goblin Thornstriders
host_02.appearance: Lanky goblins with long legs, curved spears and boots reinforced with bone spikes. They run low to the ground with their heads thrust forward.

host_03.name: Ogre Gluttons
host_03.counter: Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_03.appearance: Potbellied young ogres wear cooking pots as helmets and wield enormous kitchen mallets. Meat and stolen pans hang from their belts.

host_04.name: Orc Scrap Tinkers
host_04.appearance: Goblin warriors burdened with scrap metal, gears and strange tools. Their equipment looks assembled from a plundered human mill.

host_05.name: Bat Scouts
host_05.threat: Airborne raiders · guard the checkpoint crossings
host_05.appearance: Small orcs hang in leather harnesses beneath giant, long-eared bats. Broad wings and a downward-pointing scouting spear define their silhouette.

host_06.name: Mossback Trolls
host_06.counter: Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_06.appearance: Stocky forest trolls covered in moss and mushrooms. Overgrown runestones on their backs hint at their magical resistance.

host_07.name: Marsh Orc Hunters
host_07.counter: Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_07.appearance: Hunters in scaly leather cloaks, crocodile-jaw helmets and reeds wield barbed harpoons. Mud coats their green and brown skin.

host_08.name: Shadowblood Trolls
host_08.counter: Regenerates health; focus damage. Cloaked beyond 2 tiles; Clerics reveal within 6.
host_08.appearance: Slender, grey-blue trolls with exceptionally long arms. Their bodies dissolve into smoke; glowing blood seeps from wounds and seals them shut.

host_09.name: Goblin Dust Dancers
host_09.counter: Can evade direct physical hits; use magic.
host_09.appearance: Masked goblins carry paired curved knives and strips of a light cloak. Quick sidesteps and little dust clouds mark their evasive movements.

host_10.name: Mogrok, the Gatebreaker
host_10.counter: Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_10.appearance: A huge armored ogre drags a ripped-out castle door as a shield. His other hand holds a battering ram with an iron ram head.

host_11.name: Orc Hookbearers
host_11.counter: Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_11.appearance: Seasoned raiders with hooked blades and chains. Human helmets sit on their shoulders as trophies: the first visibly organized infantry.

host_12.name: Goblin Bell Devourers
host_12.counter: Briefly disarms nearby defenders every 8 seconds. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_12.appearance: Goblin shamans carry cracked temple bells on their backs. A strike from a bone mallet sends out a circle of violet disarming runes.

host_13.name: Red Tusk Orc Huntresses
host_13.appearance: Muscular warriors with red braids, tusks and long axes. Red handprints decorate their dark leather armor.

host_14.name: Orc Mirror Shieldbearers
host_14.counter: Shields absorb three direct hits; poison ticks and burning auras bypass them. Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_14.appearance: Heavy infantry with polished black shields. Three silver shards orbit each warrior and crack away as they absorb hits.

host_15.name: Blood Bat Riders
host_15.appearance: Orc riders on powerful red bats with torn wings. Glowing veins close gaps in the membranes to show their regeneration.

host_16.name: Orc Ash Pickpockets
host_16.counter: Magic and magical status immunity; physical or pure damage wins. Steals gold on reaching the keep. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_16.appearance: Gaunt orcs with ash-covered skin, copper masks and bulging purses. A burned rune on the chest signals their magical immunity.

host_17.name: Cursed Totem Trolls
host_17.counter: Nearby defenders attack more slowly. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_17.appearance: Hunchbacked trolls drag tall totems made from skulls and roots. Dark breath pours from each totem’s open mouth to show its intimidating presence.

host_18.name: Silent Orc Executioners
host_18.counter: Cloaked beyond 2 tiles; Clerics reveal within 6. Briefly disarms nearby defenders every 8 seconds.
host_18.appearance: Black hoods, masks with sewn-shut mouths and sickle blades. Their outlines fade when concealed; disarming attacks briefly light the blade runes.

host_19.name: Bloodwolf Orc Riders
host_19.appearance: Low riders crouch over red-eyed wolves. During a charge the wolves lower their heads, their eyes flare and dust trails behind their paws.

host_20.name: Gorvash, the Bone Patriarch
host_20.counter: Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_20.appearance: An ancient troll giant crowned with mammoth ribs. He leans on a club made from a monster’s entire spine and carries a bone throne on his back.

host_21.name: Rotroot Trolls
host_21.counter: Regenerates health; focus damage. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_21.appearance: Massive marsh trolls with roots growing through their bodies. Fresh shoots cover wounds; protective runes are carved into their woody skin.

host_22.name: Iron Ram Ogres
host_22.counter: Heavy armor; use armor reduction or magic. Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_22.appearance: Ogres sealed in plate armor with ram-shaped helmets. Almost no skin is exposed beneath broad shoulders and heavy iron mauls.

host_23.name: Shard-Soul Orc Warlocks
host_23.counter: Physical immunity; use magic or pure damage. Shields absorb three direct hits; poison ticks and burning auras bypass them. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_23.appearance: Spectral shamans with translucent bodies. Three fragments of a mirrored mask float around them; physical blows pass through their smoky torsos.

host_24.name: Riveted Goblin Mutants
host_24.appearance: Goblins trapped inside living iron frames. Each hit draws more metal plates toward their bodies before the plates loosen again.

host_25.name: Iron Bat Orc Riders
host_25.counter: Heavy armor; use armor reduction or magic.
host_25.appearance: Armored bats wear metal face masks and chest plates. Their riders carry crossbows and heavy helmets; the flight looks slow and powerful.

host_26.name: Orc Spell Eaters
host_26.counter: Magic and magical status immunity; physical or pure damage wins.
host_26.appearance: Stocky orcs with black stones embedded in their skin. Their mouths stretch into unnatural grins; magic crumbles into ash around their runes.

host_27.name: Spectral Bat Riders
host_27.counter: Nearby defenders attack more slowly. Physical immunity; use magic or pure damage.
host_27.appearance: Orc ghosts ride skeletal bats with smoky membranes. Translucency marks physical immunity; long shadows below the fliers signal intimidation.

host_28.name: Goblin Scrapwings
host_28.appearance: Goblins in flying harnesses with bat wings and riveted hulls. Reactive armor visibly closes around each pilot when struck.

host_29.name: Prismatic Bat Tricksters
host_29.counter: Can evade direct physical hits; use magic. Shields absorb three direct hits; poison ticks and burning auras bypass them.
host_29.appearance: Thin orcs on small purple bats. Three crystals form their shield; a brief colored double appears during an evasive movement.

host_30.name: Zaruun, Lord of Storm Wings
host_30.threat: Airborne raiders · guard the checkpoint crossings

variants.name: Zaruun, Lord of Storm Wings · Moon Clan

host_30.appearance: An orc warlord rides an enormous storm bat with torn wings, copper horns and lightning scars. Electrical flashes are cosmetic.

host_31.name: Orc Dual-Seal Inquisitors
host_31.counter: This wave rolls either magic or physical immunity. Shields absorb three direct hits; poison ticks and burning auras bypass them. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_31.appearance: Two appearances of the same order: Ashen warriors with black skin and orange runes, and Spectral warriors with pale, translucent bodies. Both carry three protective seals.

host_32.name: Soul-Drinker Trolls
host_32.counter: Periodically restores health. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_32.appearance: Pale trolls with a lantern suspended inside an open rib cage. Healing draws the lantern’s light through their entire body.

host_33.name: Orc Wraiths of the Shattered World
host_33.counter: Physical immunity; use magic or pure damage. Dashes forward along the route, still visiting checkpoints.
host_33.appearance: Ghosts whose bodies split into floating pieces. A vertical black rift swallows them during teleportation, then they reassemble at their destination.

host_34.name: Goblin Gallows Fliers
host_34.counter: Can evade direct physical hits; use magic. Steals gold on reaching the keep.
host_34.appearance: Goblins on gaunt bats with bone masks. Stolen purses and ropes dangle from the harnesses; riders swing beneath the bats during evasive movements.

host_35.name: Eclipse Bat Guard
host_35.counter: This wave rolls either magic or physical immunity.
host_35.appearance: Two squadrons: Ashen riders on coal-black bats and Spectral riders on translucent bats. Their colors distinguish magical and physical immunity.

host_36.name: Orc Oathbreakers
host_36.counter: This wave rolls either magic or physical immunity. Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_36.appearance: Fallen warriors with shattered royal emblems on their armor. The Ashen form bears glowing runes; the Spectral form has empty, luminous outlines beneath its plates.

host_37.name: Riftwolf Orc Riders
host_37.counter: Dashes forward along the route, still visiting checkpoints.
host_37.appearance: Riders on black wolves with violet cracks in their fur. During teleportation a wolf stretches into a thin shadow and leaps out of another rift.

host_38.name: Black Marsh Knifemen / Blood-Leech Trolls
host_38.counter: Cycles between cloak and short close-range disarms.
host_38.appearance: Knifemen are masked orcs who vanish into mist and disrupt defenders with cursed knives. Blood-Leeches are pale trolls who regenerate from red sacs on their backs.

host_39.name: Thunder Manta Orc Riders
host_39.counter: Nearby defenders attack more slowly. Reduces damage from individual direct hits. Can evade direct physical hits; use magic.
host_39.appearance: Riders on broad, leathery creatures with bony heads and armored backs. A hard carapace shows damage reduction, tilting wings signal evasion and red rider masks mark intimidation.

host_40.name: Vorlak, the Hollow Sky King
host_40.counter: Reduces damage from individual direct hits.
host_40.appearance: A huge skeletal wyvern with an orc necromancer suspended inside like a heart. A dark shell surrounds its ribs; dim light pulses in its hollow body.

host_41.name: Orc Crystal Phalanx
host_41.counter: Shields absorb three direct hits; poison ticks and burning auras bypass them. Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_41.appearance: Elite spear infantry with translucent shields of smoky crystal. Three bright nodes above each shield show its remaining protective charges.

host_42.name: Fire Bat Orc Lancers
host_42.counter: Magic and magical status immunity; physical or pure damage wins. Periodic bursts of movement speed.
host_42.appearance: Riders on black bats with orange veins in their wings. Ashen runes mark magical immunity; the wings glow during a charge.

host_43.name: Ogres of the Imprisoned Souls
host_43.counter: Nearby defenders attack more slowly. Can evade direct physical hits; use magic. Periodically restores health. Ritual wards resist magic; physical and pure attacks remain effective.
host_43.appearance: Armored ogres carry enormous cages on their shoulders. The souls inside fuel regeneration; drifting shadows and threatening masks show their other effects.

host_44.name: Orc Ash Executioners
host_44.counter: Magic and magical status immunity; physical or pure damage wins. Dashes forward along the route, still visiting checkpoints.
host_44.appearance: Tall orcs with long black axes and glowing seals. They teleport through a whirl of ash; black runes signal magical immunity.

host_45.name: Flying Drummers of the Black Horde
host_45.counter: Briefly disarms nearby defenders every 8 seconds. Pulses haste to nearby allies.
host_45.appearance: Pairs of orcs ride broad-backed bats: one steers while the other beats a troll-hide drum. Two distinct waves show disarming attacks and movement support.

host_46.name: Ogre Revenants in Hollow Armor
host_46.counter: Physical immunity; use magic or pure damage. Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_46.appearance: Enormous suits of armor held together by the spirits of dead ogres. Blue-green fire fills the gaps instead of flesh; physical attacks pass through it.

host_47.name: Orc Riders of the Last Howl
host_47.threat: Magic immunity · Dread aura · Blood rush
host_47.counter: Magic and magical status immunity; physical or pure damage wins. Nearby defenders attack more slowly. Periodic bursts of movement speed.
host_47.appearance: Fanatical riders on huge black wolves with bone masks. Burning runes signal magical immunity; charges bring red eyes and an intimidating shadow.

host_48.name: Bat Thieves of Black Fire
host_48.counter: Magic and magical status immunity; physical or pure damage wins. Briefly disarms nearby defenders every 8 seconds. Can evade direct physical hits; use magic. Steals gold on reaching the keep.
host_48.appearance: The sorcerer’s personal raiders on slender black bats. Long scarves, gold purses and disruptive rune bells accompany agile, restless flight.

host_49.name: Troll Guardians of the Deep Maw
host_49.counter: Reduces damage from individual direct hits. Periodically restores health. Plated armor reduces physical damage; break armor or add magic.
host_49.appearance: Giant trolls with obsidian carapaces and a second mouth in their bellies. Soul-light flows from the mouth during regeneration; the heavy shell marks damage reduction.

host_50.name: Ghorun, the Black Sorcerer on the Wyvern Queen
host_50.counter: Reduces damage from individual direct hits.

variants.name: Ghorun the Ashen
variants.appearance: A black wyvern queen with fiery cracks between obsidian plates. The sorcerer wears a charred black robe and carries an orange-glowing staff.

variants.name: Ghorun the Gold-Cursed
variants.appearance: Golden rune bands encircle the neck and wings; a gilded crown and dark violet magic complete the silhouette. Golden runes signal magical immunity.

variants.name: Ghorun the Pale Devourer
variants.appearance: An almost white wyvern with massive bone armor, black veins and sunken eyes. Its visibly thicker shell marks stronger damage reduction.

host_50.appearance: The final flying warlord: a dark orc sorcerer riding an exceptionally large, ancient wyvern. Three forms have distinct colors and armor.
